[font=Tahoma][color=#fce5cd][size=6][size=3][font=Arial][color=#ffffff]A ReShade preset based on Grant Wood's infamous painting of a puritan Iowan farming couple. Or are they father and daughter? What about their core values? What about [i]my [/i]values? I don't know man, but this is creeping me out.

To install, simply extract to the game folder. Run (or restart) ENBInjector every new instance you plan to run the game, then run the game's executable afterwards. Make your life easier by linking shortcuts to both files on your desktop.

Have a problem? Read the stickied FAQ in the comment section.
